Terms & Conditions

The rules of engagement when you book with us.

Home / Terms
Last updated: 1 May 2026

These Terms govern your booking, stay, and use of services provided by JuneGiri Farms Pvt. Ltd. ("we", "us"). By making a booking or staying with us, you agree to these terms.

1. Booking & confirmation

  • A booking is confirmed only after we receive 30% advance payment.
  • The balance is payable at check-in via UPI, bank transfer, or card.
  • All bookings are subject to availability and our acceptance.
  • We reserve the right to refuse bookings without explanation.

2. Check-in & ID

  • Check-in: 12:00 PM. Check-out: 11:00 AM.
  • A valid government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar / passport / driving license / voter ID) is mandatory for every guest at check-in, per Indian hospitality law.
  • Foreign nationals must carry their passport and valid visa.
  • Minors must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

3. House rules

  • Strictly vegetarian kitchen. No outside non-vegetarian food on premises.
  • No smoking inside rooms or shared indoor areas.
  • Please avoid single-use plastics and plastic bags.
  • Quiet hours: 10 PM to 6 AM.
  • Damage to property will be charged at replacement cost.
  • We reserve the right to terminate a stay without refund for serious misconduct.

4. Children & pets

  • Children under 5 stay free (no extra bed).
  • Children 5-12 charged at 50% of adult rate.
  • One medium-sized dog welcome per booking, on prior notice. ₹500/night cleaning fee.
  • Parents are responsible for children's safety on forest trails and near water bodies.

5. Liability

  • JuneGiri Farms Pvt. Ltd. is at the edge of Rajaji National Park. Wildlife encounters are possible. Guests acknowledge inherent risks of outdoor / Himalayan locations.
  • JuneGiri Farms Pvt. Ltd. is not liable for personal injury, illness, or loss of property except where caused by our gross negligence.
  • Adventure activities (rafting, bungee, treks) are booked through third-party certified operators. Their terms apply.
  • Yatra and trek pricing excludes personal/medical insurance, guests are advised to insure themselves separately.

6. Force majeure

We are not liable for cancellations, delays, or service interruptions caused by events beyond our control, natural disasters, pandemics, government orders, road closures, or political unrest. In such cases, refunds will follow our standard cancellation policy or be issued as travel credit valid for 12 months.

7. Photography & marketing

We occasionally photograph the property for marketing. We will not use photos that clearly identify you without your permission. If you'd prefer not to be photographed, let us know on arrival.

8. Cancellation

See our full Cancellation & Refund Policy.

9. Jurisdiction

These terms are governed by Indian law. Any disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand.
